description: 象前兵h边线空出 — 白方赶走黑王夺车白胜

intro.popup_en: The key difference is that the h-file is open, giving the white rook room to maneuver. White can drive the black king away with checks and then capture the rook.
intro.popup:
关键对比：h边线空出！
h线有空间让白车运转。
白方可以用将军赶走黑王，然后吃掉黑车！

outro.popup_en: With the h-file open, White can drive the black king away and capture the black rook with check.
outro.popup: 要点h线通时，白方可以赶走黑王，并且可以将军吃掉黑车！

moves.popup_en: The rook checks and drives the black king away from the corner on g8.
moves.popup:
将军驱王！
白车到g7将军，黑王被迫离开g8角落。

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced to f8, leaving the h-file open.
moves.popup: 黑王被迫去f8，h线正式空出。

moves.popup_en: The rook enters the h-file. The open file is the key to the winning plan.
moves.popup:
白车入h线！
h边线空出正是关键，白车顺利进驻h7。

moves.popup_en: The black king tries to approach its rook.
The rook checks from h8 and drives the black king away from its rook again.
moves.popup:
h8将军！
白车到h8，黑王再次被赶离黑车。

moves.popup_en: The black king escapes to d7, farther from its rook.
The white rook captures the black rook. The king is too far away to defend it, so White wins.
moves.popup:
白车吃掉黑车！白方获胜。
黑王已离得太远，无法守护黑车。
